suite_metadata.name: AI Opportunity Lab — hold-out suite
suite_metadata.purpose: Cases written independently of the engine lexicons. Tuning against this file is forbidden; it exists to measure generalisation, which is the metric v0.1 had no way to see.
suite_metadata.rule: If a rule change is made to pass a hold-out case, that case must be retired into the golden set and replaced.

cases.title: Ticket escalation on age
cases.initial_idea: When a support ticket sits unassigned for four hours, escalate it to the team lead automatically. It happens about 30 times per week and someone currently checks the queue manually.

cases.title: Loan default scoring
cases.initial_idea: We have five years of loan applications with repayment outcomes. I want to score new applicants on how likely they are to default so the credit team can prioritise reviews.

cases.title: Field manual question answering
cases.initial_idea: Our field engineers need answers from a 900-page equipment manual that is revised quarterly, and they must see the page reference for every answer. They call the depot several times a day to ask.

cases.title: Interview synthesis digest
cases.initial_idea: Turn our forty monthly user interview recordings into a themed insight digest for the product team. Two researchers spend about six hours each on this every month.

cases.title: Autonomous insurance claim decisions
cases.initial_idea: The system should approve or deny insurance claims end to end with no adjuster involved, and send the decision letter to the policyholder straight away.

cases.title: Dashboard chatbot because everyone has one
cases.initial_idea: Everyone is doing AI now. I think we should add a chatbot to our dashboard so the product looks modern. No customers have asked for it.

cases.title: External vendor email writes to live pricing
cases.initial_idea: Build an agent that reads incoming vendor emails from outside the company and updates our live pricing table directly when it spots a price change.

cases.title: Stalled marketing approvals
cases.initial_idea: Marketing spend approvals stall for weeks because nobody knows who owns the final sign-off. I want to automate the approval chain.

cases.title: Quarterly board pack narrative
cases.initial_idea: Once a quarter I spend about twenty minutes writing the narrative paragraph that goes on top of the board pack. I want AI to draft it for me.

cases.title: Discussion of automation, not a proposal
cases.initial_idea: I love reading about how companies terminate contracts and automatically reject candidates. Fascinating stuff.

cases.title: Warehouse pick-path anomaly detection
cases.initial_idea: We log every pick in the warehouse, roughly 40000 events a month across three years. I want to flag anomalous picking patterns so supervisors can investigate them.

paraphrase_pairs.purpose: Risk gates must survive rewording. v0.1 lost both gates on this pair.
paraphrase_pairs.a: An AI reviews vendor performance and automatically sends the termination notice when the vendor misses targets, with no manager approval.
paraphrase_pairs.b: Build a system that reads vendor agreements and, with no person in the loop, issues the cancellation letter when it decides the vendor has breached terms.

paraphrase_pairs.a: Employees keep asking about our internal SOPs. The library changes every few weeks. I want an assistant that answers using the latest approved SOP and shows the source section.
paraphrase_pairs.b: Staff constantly ping the ops team about our written procedures. Those documents get revised often. I want a bot that replies using the newest signed-off version and points to the exact clause.

paraphrase_pairs.purpose: Requester framing must not upgrade the architecture (framework 10.4).
paraphrase_pairs.a: Summarise our monthly survey responses into themes for the product team.
paraphrase_pairs.b: I want an autonomous agent, not a workflow, that summarises our monthly survey responses into themes for the product team.
